navigation.title: Choose an admin area
navigation.description: Use the sidebar to move through the admin workflow. The tour follows the normal order for checking a self-hosted instance.

overview.title: Start from the health summary
overview.description: Review total users, linked OAuth accounts, and active sessions first. If these metrics fail to load, check database connectivity before deeper investigation.

users.title: Review users and account links
users.description: Use Users to inspect registered users, linked OAuth providers, and user-scoped actions such as revoking all sessions.

sessions.title: Filter and revoke sessions
sessions.description: Use Sessions to narrow active, expired, or revoked tokens. Revocation is an operational action, so confirm the target user or session before running it.

audit.title: Correlate authentication events
audit.description: Audit Logs show login history and auth events. Start here when investigating failed logins, unexpected provider behavior, or suspicious activity.

valkey.title: Check ephemeral auth state
valkey.description: Valkey Status shows OAuth state and rate-limit entries. Use it to confirm whether transient authentication state is being written and cleared as expected.

db_schema.title: Understand stored data shape
db_schema.description: DB Schema gives ER relationships, table details, and row counts. Use it before changing data manually or diagnosing migration-related problems.

api_test.title: Exercise API flows carefully
api_test.description: API Test is for manual verification with real tokens. Use development credentials, confirm the target environment, and avoid destructive actions in production unless planned.
